description: Digital design sources for the gc_ctrl_top partition (issue #230): the behavioral RTL of the synthesized top and its three submodules (spi_slave, cfg_xfer, refresh_sched_rt), the klt synthesize request, the committed gate-level netlist, and the klt synthesize report (the generated Yosys script synth_gc_ctrl_top.ys is committed beside the netlist for reference but is not graded). phase_seq is NOT in this partition (gc_ctrl_top does not instantiate it) and coupled_top is not synthesized. Netlist freshness is klt synthesize --check (RTL bytes, parameters, liberty hash, netlist sha256); it needs Yosys, sv2v and the sky130A PDK, which the signoff CI runner lacks, so it is local_only: --check carries the committed outcome. Run it on a worker with those tools: klt synthesize digital/control-integration/synth/gc_ctrl_top.synth.json --pdk sky130A --check digital/control-integration/synth/gc_ctrl_top.synth.report.json. Re-attest with: klt signoff --attest 1 --inventory attest/item1.digital.json -o attest/item1.digital.envelope.json
